name: Dental (Family)
tagline: A warm, family template for dental practices — book online from day one.
description: A warm, family-friendly dental site — a soft teal-blue palette, a coral accent and rounded type, with gentle, low-anxiety copy for every age. Installs a working booking flow: real appointment types (new-patient exams, cleanings, kids’ checkups, whitening, fillings and same-day emergencies), a dentist and two hygienists booked by name with their own hours, operatories as rooms, and a reserved-chair hold policy. Ships as "Maple Grove Dental", a family dentist.
